annotations.title: Get countries for an SMS service

description: List the countries offering a quick SMS verification number for one service, with live price, delivery success rate, and whether the number is a real mobile (non-VoIP) or VoIP line. Sorted by success rate — prefer high success rates, and prefer non-VoIP when the target service blocks virtual numbers. Returns each countryId in [brackets] for order_sms_verification.

serviceId.description: The serviceId from search_sms_services (e.g. "395"), or an exact service name

name: get_sms_service_countries
